CustomField.inlineHelpText: This is a calculated field equal to “Max Redemption Fees Favor Distributor” + “Max Redemption Fees Favor ManCo” + “Max Redemption Fees Favor Subfund”. Sequantis receives each component individually rather than the calculated value. The aggregate of these components will be disclosed in the PRIIPs KID and UCITS KIID. Each component is used separately in the EMT.
CustomField.label: PRIIPS KID - Redemption Fee
